title: 7-Day Mindful Vision Immersion Retreat
shortDescription: A transformative residential retreat in Pondicherry. Daily Bates method sessions, ocular photobiomodulation, conscious breathing, and digital detox.
fullDescription: Immerse yourself in seven days of focused ocular restoration at our Pondicherry centre. This comprehensive programme is designed for individuals seeking to cultivate sustainable vision habits, dissolve chronic screen fatigue, and establish lifelong natural eye care practices under dedicated specialist guidance.
location: Tresor Nursing Home, 9, St Louis St, White Town, Puducherry – 605001, India.

itinerary.title: Arrival & Individual Ocular Assessment
itinerary.description: Orientation, baseline eye ease evaluation, and evening conscious relaxation circle.

itinerary.title: Foundations of Palming & Shifting
itinerary.description: Deep dive into Bates palming techniques, saccadic movement, and natural blinking rhythm.

itinerary.title: Photobiomodulation & Sunning Rituals
itinerary.description: Controlled solar exposure, full-spectrum daylight therapy, and contrast baths.

itinerary.title: Peripheral Vision in Nature
itinerary.description: Forest walking meditation expanding visual fields and reducing central retinal fixation strain.

itinerary.title: Digital Fatigue Reversal & Breathwork
itinerary.description: Pranayama for ocular microcirculation, screen ergonomics, and blue light recovery.

itinerary.title: Movement, Accommodation & Near-Far Shifting
itinerary.description: Dynamic eye yoga drills, fusion charts, and relaxed accommodation games.

itinerary.title: Home Practice Blueprint & Closing Circle
itinerary.description: Personalized home routine design, follow-up schedule, and certificate of completion.

inclusions: 7 Days / 6 Nights curated Pondicherry retreat accommodation
All daily organic, eye-nourishing vegetarian meals and herbal infusions
Daily 3-hour guided clinical eye yoga & therapy workshops
Full photobiomodulation sessions and sunning practice
Personalized Home Vision Practice Kit & manual
1-on-1 progress reviews with Dr. Ananya Sen and educators
preparationGuidelines: Bring current glasses and recent prescription records
Comfortable loose clothing suitable for gentle floor yoga
Hat and water bottle for morning forest walking sessions
Commitment to digital device reduction during retreat hours
